rule: Phone and chat offered only in opening hours
description: Customers can only join the phone or chat queue Mon-Fri 7:00-21:00 and Sat 8:00-17:00, never on a closed day.
problem: contacts recorded while the phones were closed
expected_note: Run 1 found 6,039 contacts offered before opening (agents logging in early); run 2 found 8 offered after closing (agents logging out late). Fixed at source and removed by remediation R01.
sql:
SELECT count(*) FROM cc.contact c JOIN cc.dim_date d ON d.full_date = c.offered_ts::date
   WHERE c.channel_id IN (1, 2) AND (d.is_center_closed
     OR (d.day_of_week = 6 AND NOT c.offered_ts::time BETWEEN '08:00' AND '17:00')
     OR (d.day_of_week < 6 AND NOT c.offered_ts::time BETWEEN '07:00' AND '21:00'))

rule: Implausibly long contacts on the latest day
description: % of answered contacts with more than 2 hours of talk time.

    SELECT coalesce(100.0 * avg((talk_sec > 7200)::int), 0) FROM cc.contact t, d WHERE answered AND t.offered_ts >= d.day AND t.offered_ts < d.day + 1

     HAVING count(DISTINCT cp.open_date) < 0.5 * least(100, discovery.snapshot_date() - min(p.introduced_date))) x

rule: Contact volume normal on the latest day
description: How far the latest day's contacts are from normal for that weekday (median of the previous four). Closed days and days explained by a holiday, event or launch count as normal.
expected_note: Refined in v3.2: replaces a minimum of 100,000 rows in total, which a missing day could never trip.
sql:
SELECT coalesce((SELECT CASE WHEN v.is_center_closed OR coalesce(v.baseline, 0) = 0 THEN 0
        WHEN discovery.volume_explanation(v.day, v.ratio) IS NOT NULL THEN 0
        ELSE round(abs(v.row_count / v.baseline - 1) * 100, 1) END
      FROM discovery.dq_daily_volume v WHERE v.run_id = {run_id} AND v.table_name = 'contact' AND v.day = discovery.period_end()), 0)
